prompt: Objective: cut a hospital's supply costs. What you've learned: supply costs rose 18% with flat patient volume. Latest finding: prices paid for the top 20 items are 15% above contract prices. What is the best next step?

options.text: Benchmark the hospital's contract prices against other hospitals
options.feedback: Secondary: the hospital isn't even paying its own contract prices.

options.text: Find out why purchases are made off-contract so often
options.feedback: Right. The gap between paid and contract prices is the lever; why it happens is next.

options.text: Work out the savings from switching to a new supplier
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix when the problem is buying off-contract.

explanation: The top 20 items cost 15% above contract. Find out why purchases are off-contract and what fixing it is worth.
